summary.text: Ken Luttrell represents Oklahoma House District 37 and previously served in the Legislature from 2006 to 2010. He is a Ponca City resident and co-chair of the House Native American Caucus.

paragraphs.text: Luttrell is a fifth-generation Oklahoman whose Cherokee ancestors settled near Grand Lake, and he has lived in Ponca City for 36 years.
He is a U.S. Army veteran, retired after 28 years of retail management with Wal-Mart and a second career in tribal public relations and economic development.
His page lists service on boards including Main Street, the Literacy Council, the Airport Advisory Board and the Ponca City Planning Commission.
He serves on the National Energy Council and the Executive Committee of the National Caucus of Native American State Legislators.
